plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 7th house makes partnership feel serious, binding, and consequential. It can support commitment, but it can also feel restrictive if fear runs the bond. Long-term potential needs tenderness, not just endurance.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
